basis: One adult, sharing a room. Mid-range totals from published 2025-2026 ranges. Not a live fare.

places.note: 6 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room: about ₹14,000 return flight plus about ₹30,000 on the ground for a guesthouse, a shared taxi, meals, and permits.
places.source: 2026 Ladakh cost guides and a September 2026 Delhi–Leh fare check. Return flights were quoted around ₹10,000–₹20,000; a mid 5–6 day land cost sits above that.

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room, usually by Volvo. About ₹3,500 for the bus and about ₹14,500 for a simple hotel, meals, and a shared sightseeing taxi.
places.source: 2025–2026 Manali budget guides: Volvo about ₹1,200–₹2,500 each way, and a 5-day land cost around ₹13,000–₹19,000 before or beside the bus.

modes.label: Flight to Kullu–Bhuntar, then a taxi
modes.duration: about 1 hour 30 minutes plus a 2 hour taxi

places.note: 6 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room. About ₹7,000 return flight and about ₹21,000 for a mid hotel, meals, a scooter, and a few activities.
places.source: 2025 Goa 5-day budgets of about ₹15,000–₹35,000 including flights, stretched to 6 days at a mid hotel.

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room, by train. About ₹2,000 for AC rail and about ₹16,000 for a haveli, meals, autos, and fort tickets.
places.source: Delhi–Jaipur is a short rail hop. A 5-day Rajasthan land cost for one city sits inside the published ₹12,000–₹30,000 band before a long-distance flight.

modes.label: Indian Railways, Shatabdi or AC chair car

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room. About ₹9,000 return flight and about ₹16,000 for a fort-area hotel, meals, and Mehrangarh.
places.source: Rajasthan 5-day mid-range guides, with a Delhi–Jodhpur flight instead of a same-day train.

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room, including a desert camp night. About ₹11,000 return flight and about ₹21,000 for the camp, meals, and a jeep or camel outing.
places.source: Rajasthan mid-range ranges, with the desert camp as the extra cost over a Jaipur or Jodhpur stay.

places.note: 6 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room. About ₹10,000 return flight and about ₹25,000 for a lakeside hotel, meals, a boat, and the palaces.
places.source: Rajasthan 5-day mid-range of about ₹32,500–₹45,000 for a longer circuit, scaled to one city for 6 days including the Delhi flight.

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room, by train. About ₹2,500 for AC rail and about ₹11,500 for a ghat hotel, meals, a boat, and the evening aarti.
places.source: Varanasi stays and ghats are inexpensive beside the Delhi train. A flight is the faster option on the same card.

modes.label: Indian Railways, AC 3-tier or Vande Bharat

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room. About ₹1,500 for the bus and about ₹12,500 for a riverside stay, meals, and one rafting trip.
places.source: Delhi to Rishikesh is an overnight bus or a train to Haridwar plus a short taxi. Rafting is the main paid activity.

modes.label: Train to Haridwar, then a taxi
modes.duration: about 5 hours plus a 1 hour taxi

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room, by train. About ₹3,000 for a fast train and about ₹13,000 for a hotel, meals, and the Wagah evening.
places.source: Delhi–Amritsar Shatabdi and Vande Bharat fares, plus a modest old-city stay. The Golden Temple itself has no entry fee.

places.note: 6 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room: Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam. About ₹10,000 return flight and about ₹26,000 for hotels, a shared cab, meals, and the gondola.
places.source: 2025–2026 Kashmir packages from Delhi with flights cluster around ₹30,000–₹38,000 for a mid 5-night trip.

places.note: 5 days from Delhi based in Srinagar, for one adult sharing a room. About ₹10,000 return flight and about ₹18,000 for a houseboat or hotel, a shikara, and meals.
places.source: Same Delhi–Srinagar fare band as the Kashmir circuit, with fewer valley transfers because the nights stay on Dal Lake.

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room: Kochi, Munnar, and a houseboat night. About ₹10,000 return flight and about ₹22,000 on the ground.
places.source: Published 5-day Munnar–Alleppey packages start near ₹22,000–₹25,000 per person before or beside a Kochi flight in the ₹8,000–₹14,000 band.

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room, flying into Kochi and staying near Periyar. About ₹10,000 return flight and about ₹20,000 for the resort, a boat, and meals.
places.source: Kochi flight band plus a wildlife-lodge stay, close to the Munnar–Alleppey package and without the houseboat.

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a jeep and a room, with safaris at both parks. The jeeps are most of the ₹36,000. Trains from Delhi are only a few thousand.
places.source: A 2025 couple budget for both parks was about ₹52,000–₹81,000 for two, which is about ₹26,000–₹40,000 a person.

modes.label: Trains toward Ramnagar and Sawai Madhopur
Flights toward Dehradun or Jaipur, then a long taxi
modes.duration: about 1 hour 30 minutes plus a 4 to 6 hour taxi

places.note: 6 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room, with a Havelock ferry and one scuba or boat day. About ₹14,000 return flight and about ₹34,000 on the islands.
places.source: 2025–2026 Andaman 7-day budgets run about ₹25,000–₹40,000 at the low end and ₹60,000–₹99,000 mid-range, including flights from the mainland.

modes.label: IndiGo / Air India / Vistara to Port Blair

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room. About ₹32,000 return flight and about ₹24,000 for a beach hotel, meals, and one island tour.
places.source: MakeMyTrip Phuket packages around ₹55,000–₹64,000 per person for 5–6 days, and Thailand mid-range guides of about ₹45,000–₹75,000 from India.

places.note: 5 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room. About ₹35,000 return flight, plus the visa levy, a shared stay, meals, and a driver or scooter. A fuller 7-day mid trip is closer to ₹90,000.
places.source: 2025 Bali group-trip breakdowns from India: about ₹64,000 budget to ₹93,000 mid for 7 days. This card is the shorter 5-day version.

places.note: 6 days from Delhi for one adult sharing a room on a local island, not a water villa. About ₹22,000 return flight and about ₹68,000 for the stay, speedboats, and meals. Resort packages with flights are often ₹1.1–1.5 lakh.
places.source: 2025 Maldives budget guides of ₹45,000–₹65,000 for 5 guesthouse days, and 4-night flight packages listed from about ₹55,000 to ₹1.2 lakh.
